title: Support filtering GET /books by author and tag
body:
Clients need to filter the catalogue:

- `GET /books?author=martin` → books whose author contains the text (case-insensitive)
- `GET /books?tag=craft` → books that have exactly that tag
- both filters can be combined; with no filters the full list is returned as today.

Please add tests.

Add filtering to GET /books by author substring and tag exact match.
1. Update GET /books route handler to support author and tag filters.
2. Add tests for filtering GET /books by author and tag.
